changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE patient_problems DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_patient_problems_source_required;

ALTER TABLE patient_problems ADD CONSTRAINT ck_patient_problems_source_required CHECK ( patient_is_free = true OR ( patient_is_free = false AND by_patient IS NOT NULL AND ( by_patient = true OR ( by_patient = false AND source_of_information IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(source_of_information) <> '' ) ) ) );
